# Code of conduct

Harpsistudio is a small open-source project. Everyone participating in issues,
pull requests, discussions, and reviews is expected to be respectful and
constructive.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, deliberate
intimidation, publishing someone's private information, and sustained personal
attacks. Technical disagreement is fine; make it about the code and the user
experience.

Maintainers may edit or remove comments, close threads, or reject contributions
that violate these expectations. Repeated or serious violations may result in
being blocked from the project.

If you need to report a conduct issue, contact the maintainers privately through
the repository profile rather than escalating it in a public thread. Do not use
the security advisory channel for ordinary conduct reports.

This policy is informed by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
It applies to project spaces and to public communication made on the project's
behalf.
